app.name: MineMyDinner
app.tagline: Dig tonight's dinner out of your saved recipes and your fridge.

language.label: Language
language.switchWarning: Switching the language will lose {count, plural, one {# unsaved draft} other {# unsaved drafts}}, including their paid extractions.

import.title: Import recipes
import.textLabel: Paste one recipe's text, or one web link
import.screenshotsHint: 1 to 5 PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, up to 10 MB each. They are kept on this computer with the recipe.
import.batchHint: Separate dishes with a line of ---, or with blank lines. Up to 50 dishes. Links in the file are saved as sources but not opened.
import.pasteSuggestion: This page could not be read. Copy the recipe text from the page and paste it above.
import.batchQueued: {count, plural, =0 {No dishes were extracted.} one {# dish is ready for review.} other {# dishes are ready for review.}}
import.modelNotice: Text, page content, and screenshots you import are sent to a third-party AI model to read the recipe. Leave out personal information.
import.textHint: One recipe at a time. For several recipes, use the text file import below.
import.urlHint: One web page at a time. Import several pages one by one.
import.rightsNotice: Import only content you may use, such as recipes you wrote, your own notes, or content shared for personal use.
import.storageNotice: Imported recipes and their source are kept only on this computer, for your own use.

errors.monthly_cap: This month's model spending cap is reached. Raise LLM_MONTHLY_CAP_USD or try next month.
errors.models_unavailable: No model is available right now. Try again later.
errors.invalid_url: This is not a valid http or https link.
errors.blocked_address: This link points to a local or private address, which is not allowed.
errors.robots_disallowed: This site's robots.txt does not allow reading this page.
errors.fetch_failed: The page could not be loaded.
errors.not_html: This link is not a web page.
errors.no_main_text: No recipe text was found on the page. It may need a login.
errors.text_too_large: The text is too long. Keep it under 20,000 characters.
errors.unsupported_image_type: Use PNG, JPEG, or WebP images.
errors.image_too_large: An image is larger than 10 MB. Compress it and try again.
errors.images_unreadable: The images can no longer be read. The original files may have been moved or changed; choose them again.
errors.too_many_items: The file has more than 50 dishes.
errors.unreadable_encoding: The file's text encoding could not be read. Save it as UTF-8.
errors.invalid_parent: The parent entry is not valid.
errors.unknown_ingredient: An ingredient link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.unknown_cookware: A cookware link is not valid. Link it again.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.
errors.in_inventory: This ingredient is in your inventory. Remove it from inventory first, then change how it is recorded.
errors.has_children: Other entries list this one as their parent, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.used_by_rule: A dietary rule uses this entry, so it cannot be deleted. Remove the rule first.
errors.not_found: It no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_for_stock_mode: These amounts do not fit how this ingredient is recorded.
errors.self_diner: Your own record cannot be deleted.
errors.empty_rule: Choose or type what the rule is about.
errors.diet_word: Rules by food category are not supported yet. Add each ingredient they do not eat (such as pork, beef, chicken, fish, shrimp).
errors.several_links: Import one link at a time.
errors.several_recipes: Paste one recipe at a time. For several recipes, use the text file import with a line of --- between them.
errors.internal: Something went wrong while planning. You can try again.
errors.thread_not_found: This conversation was not found. Start a new one.
errors.nothing_pending: There is no question waiting for an answer.

review.title: Review recipe
review.empty: There are no drafts to review.
review.unsavedNotice: Drafts are kept only on this page. Reloading or closing it loses them, and they would need to be extracted again.
review.suppliesHint: Things that get used up, such as plastic wrap or foil. A reminder only; they never affect suggestions.
review.severalRecipes: This text seems to hold {count} recipes; only the first was read. Split them with a line of --- and import again.
review.aliasConflict: Not remembered, already a name or alias of another entry: {names}
review.saveFailed: Saving failed: {error} Your edits are kept.
review.allergyWarning: Allergy warning. The recipe can still be saved.
review.allergenConflict: {name} contains {allergen}, which you are allergic to.
review.ruleConflict: {name} matches one of your allergy rules.
review.checkYourself: Allergen information comes from the dictionary and automatic reading, and may be wrong. Go by the actual ingredients and package labels.
review.discardQuestion: Discard this draft? Its paid extraction is lost, and getting it back needs a new extraction.
review.screenshotsKept: The screenshots are saved with the recipe and can be viewed in the library.
review.imagesFailed: The recipe is saved, but its screenshots are not: {error}
review.fixAmounts: Fix the amounts marked above before saving.
review.choiceHint: When the method lets ingredients stand in for each other, hold “⠿ Drag” and drop one line onto another to form a pick-one card; drag a line out of the card to take it back out.
review.choiceCard: Pick one: any one of these is needed
review.choiceCardOptional: Pick one: the whole group can be left out; pick one if used
review.dropOut: Drop here to leave the choice

line.name: Name
line.skipped: Not linked: this line is saved, but its allergens count as unknown.
line.notNeededDone: Not needed: not saved, and planning does not check this cookware.
line.nameConflict: The name “{name}” is the dictionary entry “{entry}”, but this line is linked to “{linked}”.
line.zeroAmount: The amount must be more than 0.

entry.ownedName: "{term}" is already a name or alias of "{entry}".

allergens.title: Allergens
allergens.suggested: A model suggested these. They take effect only after you confirm.
allergens.noneSuggested: The model suggested none. This does not confirm that there are none.
allergens.unavailable: Suggestions are unavailable. You can still choose allergens or leave them unknown.

library.title: Recipe library
library.deleteNotice: Saved menus still show this dish's name. Its ratings and notes are deleted; recipes made from it are kept.
library.noEmbedding: Not yet searchable by meaning; it is retried automatically.
library.loadFailed: The recipe could not be loaded.

recipeDetail.failed: The recipe could not be loaded.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.cookwareOwnedHint: Cookware you own. Plans only suggest dishes you can make with it.
inventory.stockHint: What you have at home right now; plans check dishes against it to see what you can make and what is missing. Give a count for things you count, mark the rest as plenty or low, and remove them when they run out.
inventory.availabilityHint: Being listed here means you have it. Delete it when it runs out.
inventory.alwaysInStockHint: Things you always have, like salt, oil, and soy sauce. Plans treat them as always in stock, with no amounts to track.

people.title: People
people.friendHint: A nickname is enough; no full name is needed. When planning meals, friends' names are replaced with codes such as “Diner 1” before anything is sent to the AI model.
people.nicknameWarning: This nickname also appears in ingredient names and may be misread when planning; consider a longer nickname.
people.deleteFriendNotice: This friend's dietary rules are deleted too. Saved menus are not affected.

dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.unresolvedHint: We don't know yet whether these ingredients contain allergens. Until you confirm, dishes that use them are not suggested when anyone at the table has an allergy. Confirm their allergens, or link the name to an ingredient you already have.
dictionary.suggestedNote: Category and stock mode are suggested from the name; you can change them.
dictionary.linkNotRemembered: Linked "{name}" to "{entry}", but "{name}" already belongs to another entry, so it was not remembered.
dictionary.seedNotice: Ingredients you added yourself; you can edit or delete them. Built-in ingredients are under "All ingredients": they can't be changed, but you can add your own names for them.
dictionary.allCookwareHint: Every cookware item, built-in and your own.
dictionary.userCookwareHint: Cookware you added yourself; you can delete it. Built-in cookware is under "All cookware".
dictionary.browseHint: Every ingredient, built-in and your own. Search by name, alias, or category; use "My aliases" to add your own names. To edit an ingredient you added, go to "My ingredients".
dictionary.personalAliasesHint: Your own wordings for this ingredient, separated by commas. Lines already imported with these words are linked too.
dictionary.deleteIngredientNotice: {count, plural, one {# dish uses it} other {# dishes use it}}. After deleting, those lines become unlinked and their allergens count as unknown.
dictionary.deleteCookwareNotice: {count, plural, one {# dish needs it} other {# dishes need it}}. After deleting, those dishes no longer record that they need it.

chat.title: Plan a meal
chat.inputPlaceholder: For example: two dishes for tonight, use what I have
chat.providerNotice: Your messages are sent to an AI model provider to plan meals. Conversations are kept on this computer.
chat.allergenNotice: Always check the actual ingredients for allergens yourself. Dictionary entries and extraction can be wrong, so this plan is not a safety guarantee.

progress.context: Checking your fridge and dietary rules…
progress.check: Checking the plan against the rules…

requestStyle.title: When you leave details out, such as how many people or whether to shop, how should I handle it?
requestStyle.switchLabel: Ask me first when details are missing

diners.title: Who is eating? ({count} in all)
diners.headcountChanged: The number of people is now {count}.
diners.nudge: You mentioned a dietary limit. Please check that it is filled in.
diners.dietHint: Rules by food category are not supported yet. Add each ingredient they do not eat (such as pork, beef, chicken, fish, shrimp).
diners.byWordingHint: Not found in the dictionary, so it is matched by the words in recipe lines and may match loosely.
diners.profileNote: Changes here update the profile right away.
diners.saveFriend: Save to friend profiles (ask them first)
diners.unmatched: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} not matched yet
diners.more: {count, plural, one {# more person} other {# more people}}

welcome.fridge: Two dishes and a soup, using only what is in the fridge
welcome.shopping: Dinner for three, and shopping is fine

question.hint: To plan this, tell me {fields}. Your next message answers it.
question.mode: whether to cook only from the fridge or to shop as well

plan.title: Plan
plan.servingsNote: The {title} recipe serves {servings}; you're cooking for {headcount, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}, so scale up the ingredients.
plan.leftOut: {count, plural, one {# dish was left out because an ingredient has an unknown allergen.} other {# dishes were left out because an ingredient has an unknown allergen.}}
plan.semanticPaused: Search by meaning is paused for now, so results may be less relevant. Searching by name still works.
plan.askedMeat: {bound, select, at_least {at least } at_most {at most } other {}}{count, plural, one {# meat dish} other {# meat dishes}}
plan.askedVegetable: {bound, select, at_least {at least } at_most {at most } other {}}{count, plural, one {# vegetable dish} other {# vegetable dishes}}
plan.assumedMeat: {count, plural, one {# meat dish} other {# meat dishes}}
plan.assumedVegetable: {count, plural, one {# vegetable dish} other {# vegetable dishes}}
plan.reasons: Why this plan could not be made
plan.dinersLineOthers: Checked against: {names}; {count, plural, one {# more person has} other {# more people have}} unknown limits
plan.dinersOthersOnly: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} unknown limits
plan.leftOutKnown: The dictionary knows this name, but this dish's ingredient line is not linked to it, so the dish stays left out. Link the line to an entry below.
plan.leftOutNothingLinked: No unlinked line with this name was found, so the dish stays left out. Check it on the dictionary page.
plan.leftOutCreateInstead: Not listed? Create a new entry
plan.leftOutLinkInstead: Link to an existing entry instead

warning.S3: Something in your fridge expires on {date} and this plan does not use it.
warning.S5: {count, plural, =2 {Both dishes are} other {All # dishes are}} the same type ({dishType}).
warning.S7estimated: {title}: the cooking time ({minutes} min) is only an estimate.
warning.S7total: The total cooking time ({total} min) is well over your {limit} min limit.
warning.S8diners: {count, plural, one {# other diner has} other {# other diners have}} unknown dietary limits; please check them yourself.

chat.replanMessage: Plan again with the same request

actionMessage.relax_split: Any mix of meat and vegetable dishes is fine

problem.split_conflicts_total: The meat and vegetable counts do not fit the total number of dishes. Tell me the counts again.
problem.split_exceeds_total: The meat and vegetable dishes add up to more than the total number of dishes. Tell me the counts again.
problem.too_many: That is more than I can plan at once, at most 12 dishes in total. Tell me how many you want.
